items.name: Interchangeable floating-card montage
items.trigger: Several cards float independently without a causal, spatial, or attention relationship.
items.why_it_fails: The frame can fit almost any SaaS product and does not explain how the product creates the result.
items.repair: Choose one persistent object and show a truthful action-to-result relationship.
items.exceptions: A brief category overview may use a montage when the diversity itself is the message.

items.name: Dashboard wallpaper
items.trigger: A full interface is shown at a scale where the relevant product evidence cannot be read.
items.why_it_fails: The UI signals software without proving the scene's claim.
items.repair: Crop, stage, or simplify around the relevant state while preserving enough context for truth.
items.exceptions: An establishing shot may show system scale before moving to readable detail.

items.name: Decorative motion without information change
items.trigger: Objects bounce, orbit, or morph while the viewer learns no new relationship or state.
items.why_it_fails: Motion competes with the message and makes timing feel templated.
items.repair: Tie movement to entry, state change, causality, hierarchy, continuity, or exit.
items.exceptions: A short brand punctuation may be expressive if it does not interrupt comprehension.

items.name: Same composition at every beat
items.trigger: Scenes repeat a centered card plus heading even when their communication jobs differ.
items.why_it_fails: The sequence has no visual escalation and makes every claim feel equal.
items.repair: Vary scale, relationship, or state only where the narrative job changes; preserve continuity anchors.
items.exceptions: A deliberate repeated comparison needs stable geometry and visibly changing evidence.

items.name: Claim before mechanism
items.trigger: A broad value statement appears without product action, evidence, or a later explicit proof beat.
items.why_it_fails: The sequence feels like generic marketing copy placed over abstract visuals.
items.repair: Show or set up the mechanism as the claim is made and connect it to the result.
items.exceptions: A short opening tension or positioning line may precede proof when the next beat resolves it.

items.name: Reference collage
items.trigger: A scene combines recognizable composition, palette, typography, or signature choreography from a source work.
items.why_it_fails: It copies expression instead of transferring an abstract communication principle.
items.repair: Return to the source's problem/mechanism, then rebuild with client objects, brand, constraints, and a different sequence.
items.exceptions: None without rights and explicit human direction; even then, provenance must be recorded.

items.name: Flattened editability
items.trigger: Text, UI, or layout promised as editable is imported as one raster image.
items.why_it_fails: The handoff cannot support normal production changes.
items.repair: Create native nodes or label the raster boundary and provide the source asset.
items.exceptions: A real product screenshot may remain raster when truthful capture matters more than reconstruction.

items.name: Unreadable state jump
items.trigger: A causal transformation has only a final frame and no visible before/action boundary or transition anchor.
items.why_it_fails: Production must invent the mechanism, and the viewer may miss why the result changed.
items.repair: Add the minimum boundary states and semantic anchor needed to explain the change.
items.exceptions: A result-only scene is valid when causality was established immediately before it.
